The team's editor for one product, in the app shell. It covers:

- the basics and the pictures, with [upload](/components/upload/) for new ones;
- the finishes as a [table](/components/table/) of inputs: color, name, SKU and stock;
- the price, with what's left after the cost;
- the status as [options](/components/choice/), the collection and tags;
- a live preview of how it reads in search results.

Nothing saves on its own. A frosted bar floats up with the first change, and leaving the page
asks first.

<Template name="edit-product" />

## Try it

- Change the price: the margin follows, and the **Unsaved changes** bar appears.
- Set the price above the **Price before**, or give two finishes the same SKU, then save.
  A summary at the top lists each problem as a link to its field.
- Add a tag with Enter and take it off with Backspace. Remove a finish and undo it.

## Details that matter

- **One save for everything,** with **Discard** beside it, instead of fields that save as you type
  and can't be taken back.
- **The error summary takes focus** and links to each field; the fields are marked and say what's
  wrong under them.
- **Counters for what search engines cut:** 60 characters for the title, 160 for the description.
- **The one glass is the save bar,** floating over the page; the cards are content.
